body.name: LIT
body.space: canonically indexed action-assignment and factor-request literals
body.def: \(\mathrm{LIT}=\{(a,x):a\in\mathcal A,\ x\text{ is an allowed value recorded for }a\}\sqcup\{(j,v,x):j\in[k],\ v\text{ occurs in the transformed ancestry requested by }C_j,\ x\in\mathfrak X_v\}\).
